title: Number Icon in Notification Area Font Size
symptom: The double digit font is readable for the Number Icon notification, but the triple digit font size becomes much smaller and harder to read.
cause: The view is controlled by the android framework and it is not possible to change the width or height of the icon.
fix: No fix is provided; it is stated that it isn't possible to increase the number icon font size due to space limitations.
evidence_quote: It isn't possible to increase the number icon font size due to space limitations in that area.
